Design of 3d phase of Community Policing in Albania

description.narrative: Förbereder projektförslaget för genomförandet av fas 3 av gemenskapspolisen i Albanien.
Preparing the project proposal for the implementation of the phase 3 of Community Policing in Albania.

The objective of this intervention is to design the third phase of the Strengthening Community Policing Programme in Albania, through the mobilization of an expert team from DECAF, made up by international and national consultants.
The third phase will be designed in response to the Albanian State Police request for a continuation of the ongoing second phase of the cooperation programme. The request has also delineated the directions and the scope of the third phase.

The intervention has achieved its goal by developing a well-consulted and fully endorsed project proposal, within the agreed time. The Proposal got effective inputs from the beneficiaries, the Albanian State Police (ASP) and Ministry of Interior. It did also receive contributions from other parties like civil society, other line ministries and security and public order experts and went through a few revisions following the Sida/Embassy comments. The Program Proposal was used as intended, to launch a tender process for the procurement of the implementing consultant of the program.
